findings.issue: Mobile bottom navigation bar fixed at bottom with no content padding compensation
findings.impact: Last messages and input area partially hidden behind 3.5rem fixed nav bar on mobile screens
findings.fix: Add padding-bottom of 3.5rem to the main content scroll container to account for fixed bottom nav

findings.issue: Empty channel state lacks actionable guidance or onboarding context for new users
findings.impact: New users joining an empty channel may be uncertain how to begin participating
findings.fix: Add contextual empty state with channel purpose, onboarding hints, or a clickable 'Say hello!' suggestion

findings.issue: No feedback when @mention query matches no channel members
findings.impact: Users may be confused why @mention autocomplete is not responding; no indication that the name doesn't exist
findings.fix: Show a 'No members found matching query' message below the input when filteredMembers is empty and mentionQuery is active

findings.issue: Sidebar category drag-and-drop lacks drag ghost image and channel-to-category drag support
findings.impact: Drag-and-drop feels unpolished; channels cannot be dragged between categories, only via API
findings.fix: Add drag ghost image via e.dataTransfer.setDragImage(), show drop zone indicators for channels, and enable channel-to-category drag

findings.issue: Priority warning and @everyone modals do not restore focus to message input after close
findings.impact: Keyboard navigation flow is interrupted after modal confirmations; keyboard users must tab back to input manually
findings.fix: After modal close, call tiptapRef.current?.commands.focus() or manually focus the editor element

findings.issue: Mobile thread panel uses ArrowLeft icon for close — ambiguous UX pattern
findings.impact: Users may expect ArrowLeft to navigate back in browser history rather than close the thread panel
findings.fix: Use X icon consistently for closing mobile RHS panels, or add close label text alongside ArrowLeft

findings.issue: Search bar placeholder text may overflow on narrow mobile screens
findings.impact: Minor visual overflow on very narrow viewports where search bar max-width is constrained
findings.fix: Use shorter placeholder on mobile (e.g., 'Search...') or remove max-width constraint on small screens

findings.issue: Status picker positioned with hardcoded bottom:48px offset relative to sidebar container
findings.impact: Status picker may render at wrong position if sidebar footer layout height changes
findings.fix: Position status picker relative to the avatar button using dynamic top calculation or portal-based positioning

findings.issue: Reaction tooltip uses native HTML title attribute — not keyboard accessible, no user names shown
findings.impact: Reaction tooltips cannot be triggered by keyboard and do not display names of who reacted
findings.fix: Add proper tooltip component listing names of users who reacted on hover/focus, or use aria-label with aggregated count

findings.issue: Settings and admin page content unknown — may lack loading states or permission checks
findings.impact: Unknown UX quality for settings and admin flows; potential missing loading/error states
findings.fix: Verify settings and admin pages have loading skeletons, permission checks, and consistent layout with workspace shell

findings.issue: OnboardingTour component always rendered but trigger logic unclear — may not activate for new users
findings.impact: New users may miss guided onboarding if tour trigger condition is not properly configured
findings.fix: Verify onboarding tour trigger is functional and appears for newly created user accounts on first workspace visit

findings.issue: User-generated markdown content rendered via ReactMarkdown without href sanitization on link renderer
findings.impact: Potential XSS vector through crafted markdown links using javascript: or other dangerous URI schemes in the custom 'a' component override
findings.fix: Add href sanitization to the link renderer validating against dangerous URI schemes, and consider DOMPurify as additional defense layer

findings.issue: Socket connection listener cleanup may not execute if getSocket() promise is pending during unmount
findings.impact: Potential socket event listener leak on rapid channel switches causing duplicate message handlers or memory leaks
findings.fix: Use cancellable promise pattern or ref to track cancellation state ensuring cleanup runs regardless of socket connection status

findings.issue: Workspace layout returns null on missing user without error UI for workspace fetch failures
findings.impact: Blank screen if workspace API fails after authentication succeeds; no retry mechanism or error messaging
findings.fix: Add error state for workspace fetch failures with retry button, clear messaging, and fallback UI instead of returning null

findings.issue: File upload handler lacks client-side file size, type, and extension validation
findings.impact: Users may upload oversized files or disallowed file types (scripts, executables) wasting bandwidth and creating security risk
findings.fix: Add client-side file validation: max file size check (50MB), allowed MIME type whitelist, and reject executable extensions before upload

findings.issue: Socket.io client missing explicit heartbeat (ping/pong) configuration for unreliable networks
findings.impact: Silent disconnections on unreliable mobile networks where client thinks it's connected but server timed out
findings.fix: Configure Socket.io client with explicit pingTimeout (20000) and pingInterval (25000) for mobile-friendly reconnection

findings.issue: Reduced motion handled via inline script instead of CSS media query in stylesheet
findings.impact: Minor; inline script increases root layout size and runs on every page load unnecessarily
findings.fix: Move reduced motion handling to CSS: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) setting animation-duration: 0.01ms !important

findings.issue: Avatar images rendered with unoptimized img tag instead of Next/Image component
findings.impact: Larger than necessary image bytes on the wire; no automatic lazy loading, responsive sizing, or format optimization
findings.fix: Replace with Next.js Image component with explicit width/height and remotePatterns in next.config.ts
